# Best MagSafe car mounts (as of Oct 2026)

For most iPhone drivers, I'd pick the **Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W vent mount** ($47.99). Three of the guides I found name it best overall. It charges at up to 15W and rotates between portrait and landscape. The box also includes a 1 m USB-C cable and a 27W car adapter, so you don't need to buy a power source separately. It fits cases up to 3 mm thick. ([RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [CloudsPress](https://www.cloudspress.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/))

## Other good picks

- **Fastest: Anker Prime Qi2 25W AirCool vent mount, $89.99.** It has active cooling and is the pick if you have an iPhone 16 or 17. You'll need a 30W+ USB-C PD car charger to reach 25W, and the vent and power requirements are stricter. ([The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)) The Gadgeteer says a 60W adapter is included. Mountguys uses the Anker Prime as its own daily driver. ([Mountguys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/))
- **Best value with a cooling fan: ESR HaloLock 15W with CryoBoost, $39.99** at ESR's US store. It's Qi2-certified and mounts on a vent or the dash. Dealectric lists a code, PARTNER18, that brings it to $32.80 (it says the code expires 2026-12-31). The fan helps if Maps makes your phone overheat. The product page doesn't say whether a car adapter is included, so check before buying. [Buy at ESR via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost) (affiliate link; Dealectric is paid if you buy). Details: [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/answers/best-magsafe-car-mount-2026-reviews-qi2)
- **Budget 25W with fan: LISEN Qi2.2 25W car mount, from $39.95.** The Gadgeteer picked it as best overall for iPhone 16/17, with a bundled 95W adapter. ([The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/))
- **Poor vents or a truck:** Belkin's vent/dash version suits awkward vents. Mountguys recommends the RAM Drill Down mount for trucks and off-road driving. ([Mountguys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/))

## Things to check

- **Qi2 badge:** A "MagSafe-compatible" listing without Qi2 may charge at only about 7.5W. ([The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/))
- **Case:** You need a MagSafe or Qi2 magnetic case if your phone isn't natively magnetic, including Samsung S25/S26 phones.
- **Heat:** A fan helps on hot dashboards, where charging can slow down.
- **Links:** I only have a direct purchase link for the ESR mount. For the others, the guides above list current retailers, and prices may have changed.

If you tell me your phone model and whether you'd mount on a vent or the dash, I can narrow it to one pick.
